responsibility: Provides the C-family frontend glue for the Arm target. It implements overloaded-builtin resolution needed for Arm CDE/MVE ACLE interfaces, emits C-specific EABI object attributes that depend on frontend types, defines the large set of Arm preprocessor builtins and feature macros that reflect the active architecture, ABI, floating-point, SIMD, security, and extension settings, and registers Arm-specific pragma handling so `#pragma GCC target` can reparse target options and refresh predefined macros in C/C++ compilation.
